title: Browser runtime, personas and sign-in recovery
situations: Browser on an unconnected test host
Resettable machine must retain live logins
current: Browser QA defaults an omitted identity to default, allowing anonymous cases even when named identities declare sites. Authorize and verify refuse an omitted --identity when default has no sites and another identity does, naming the choices. Mission dispatch uses explicit case personas or project identities covering the target origin. Source tests cover selection; live sign-in proof remains required.
questions: Live identity persistence and individual site probes were not exercised; current docs/CLI contract, not a sign-in guarantee.
